title: Atomized Rateboard: Tradeoffs & Compact Cost Slate
creator: Aisha Clarke
description:
Problem: Customers need a compact, composable view in the Console to understand per-token economics across multiple pricing bands and export scenarios without leaving the page. Current cost panes are long tables or heavy charts that make quick tradeoff analysis and export presets cumbersome.

Goal: Design an "atomized rateboard" — a compact slate that lets users: 1) see per-token cost broken down by model variant, quantization, and batch settings; 2) toggle pricing bands and immediately preview invoice delta; 3) create and export lightweight rate presets (CSV/JSON) for billing and chargeback workflows; 4) surface attribution to routes and prompt templates. The slate should be embeddable in Dashboards, Instance/Model pages, and Rollout configuration flows.

Scope: Visual design and interaction patterns only (no runtime pricing engine). Deliver a high-fidelity prototype showing three states: baseline, compare (two scenarios side-by-side), and compact export composer. Provide developer-ready specs for tokens-per-second hover, estimate accuracy badges, and keyboard-friendly rate adjustments.

Non-goals: Full billing export format spec, server-side pricing calculation, or taxonomy changes to SKU names.

Design principles: rapid scanability, predictable export outputs, minimal vertical real-estate, and clear signal of uncertainty (estimates vs. recorded spend).
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes baseline slate, compare mode, and export composer reachable in <=3 clicks
Per-token breakdown rows for model variant, quantization, batching, and cache hit applied
Interactive pricing band slider with immediate invoice delta preview and confidence badge
Export presets allow CSV and compact JSON with field mapping options and preview
Accessibility: keyboard nav and screen reader labels for all interactive controls
Handoff doc includes component specs (spacing, tokens, micro-interactions) and example API payloads for frontend wiring
